verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports self-hosting 'on your own infrastructure with full data ownership,' which lets an AI-native user effectively choose where data resides by deploying in their preferred region, but there is no explicit cloud-based region/residency selection feature documented. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-region hosting option or data-residency control panel within the managed/cloud offering, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
